before_listening.en: Someone describes a friend. Listen for what she looks like.
before_listening.ar: واحدة بتوصف صاحبتها. ركّز على شكلها.

segments.speaker: Mona
segments.text: My friend Nadia is tall and she has got long black hair. She is twenty years old. She is very kind and she is always happy. She has got a big blue bag. Her bag is old, but she loves it. Nadia has got a new phone. It is small and white. She lives in a big flat with her family. Her flat is near my house. Nadia is a good friend.

questions.q: What do we learn about Nadia's bag?
questions.q_ar: إيه اللي عرفناه عن شنطة نادية؟
options: It is old, but she loves it
In a big flat near the speaker's house
In a small flat far away
